params.body: public/favicon.ico still held the old three-stripes mark. Chrome falls back to /favicon.ico when a page takes long to settle or an icon link is not yet resolved, which showed the old logo on the vehicle detail page. It is now the same 48x48 PNG as /favicon.png (a PNG in an .ico slot is accepted by all current browsers, and that is what the file already was).
params.title: favicon.ico: the new mark
